reviews.comment: Modern/Abstract Algebra (MATH 415/433) are difficult courses to begin with, but Professor Huang does not offer any support in making it easier. Exams are weighted very heavily, especially the final, and she does not offer any review for the first two exams. Also often seemed unavailable to questions or wouldn't answer them clearly.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor! Sucks at lecturing, just copies textbook terms onto whiteboard without good explanation. Lectures too fast and with heavy accent, very hard to keep up. Only uses complex terminology without making it understandable for the students. Doesn't provide any exam prep material and homework problems are not seen on exam.

Notes aren't posted, HW solutions aren't posted, no practice exams so you don't really know what to expect for exams. Not a lot of examples of application shown in class and the ones that are shown aren't really explained very well. Would not recommend.

I enjoyed taking Dr. Huang for linear algebra. Her lectures were quite dull but she went over the material necessary for doing the weekly homeworks and exams. As long as you do the homework, the exams are not too difficult.

She's a sweet lady but doesn't do the best at teaching. Her lectures are very theoretical and hard to understand, however she does do a lot of in class examples that teach you how to do the homeworks and exams. If you get her it's okay and very doable, but there are probably better options out there.

Hang Huang's lectures consist of her transferring her notes to the whiteboard. She has a heavy accent, but does attempt to explain the steps of a given operation. Student questions rarely receive satisfactory answers, especially when they're related to why we should approach a problem a certain way or why a given technique is useful.

In her defense, this semester sucked in terms of planning lecture material. The main reason she flew through everything in lecture was because she had to in order to cover it all. That being said, there is opportunity for improvement, and I think/hope she will get better over time.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Huang's teaching just made learning extra hard. Overall, it's extra hard to pay attention in her class. Although she is bright and rarely makes mistakes, she explains super poorly because she just uses technical terms and isn't articulate. She doesn't put which chapters are covered for quizzes also and she was always rushing.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: I have gotten A's in all of my other Calculus classes up until now. Professor Haung is by far the worst Math teacher I have ever had. Classes are rushed through generally, homework is fine but does not prepare you for the exam. If you can help it, do not take this course with her.
Dr. Huang is not good at explaining the materials so lecture can be pretty confusing. She drops few quizzes and homework grades so that's a little helpful.

Professor Huang appears to rush through materials in lectures and it is not uncommon for questions in class to go ignored. Her lectures are very had to understand at times, I ended up using another professors pre-recorded lectures that explain material much more thoroughly. I would recommend finding another professor for MATH 251.

Professor Huang is knowledgeable about material, but just can't seem to teach well. She has a very heavy Chinese accent which can be very difficult to understand. Her notes are disorganized, although I will have to say she uploads them quickly. Homework is on webassign and quizzes are on gradescope. Definitely below average. Don't take
